messages:
Alex (infra): heads-up — handing off the midday shift. brief summary: we saw a latency spike in the tokenizer service starting ~11:02 UTC, client P95 for text-generation jumped to ~22s and some requests started timing out. oncall-bot paged at 11:05 for increased 5xx and latency alerts.
Priya N: thanks. is this still ongoing? any customer-facing incidents declared?
Alex (infra): still active but mitigations applied. customers saw errors and long tails for about 11:02–11:12. we set incident = S2 for now (customer-visible, partial). ticket created: INC-7214. link to minimal notes + logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/tokenizer/534321
oncall-bot: Pager triggered: tokenizer-service high_error_rate (11:05 UTC). Pager details: 12 pages, severity: P2.
Shane L: quick note on root cause hypothesis — yesterday's tokenizer batcher tweak (kv-prefetch enabled) increased memory churn under medium burst traffic, causing GC pauses and stall on the worker JVMs. saw OOM-adjacent GC spikes in JVM stats at host g-12-03.
Maria T: what mitigations did we do so far?
Alex (infra): actions taken:
- rolled back kv-prefetch flag on the tokenizer fleet at 11:07 (rollback id: deploy-2026-11-kv-prefetch).
- scaled tokenizer-workers from 3 -> 8 in us-east-1 (kubectl: `kubectl scale deploy/tokenizer-workers -n inference --replicas=8`) at 11:08.
- temporarily routed 30% traffic to fallback tokenizers in us-west (smart-router policy) at 11:09.
Observed effect: error rate dropped ~70% within 2 minutes; latency P95 came down to ~3.2s by 11:11 but some tails remained for long requests.
Priya N: good. any customers still impacted? is there an open escalation with sales/CS?
Shane L: checked customer impact dashboard: ~1100 API calls failed or timed out during the 10-minute window. Most customers recovered after routing and scale. flagged 3 high-volume customers — outreach from CS queued. Maria, can you own the customer comms?
Maria T: I can. I'll ping CS and draft a note with timeline + mitigation. ETA 30m. tagging @sales-ops separately.
Alex (infra): operations notes for incoming on-call:
- primary: Alex (infra) (me) -> handing to Priya N (primary)
- secondary: Shane L -> stays on rotation for deeper infra debug
- coverage gap: APAC region had limited autoscaler headroom; we didn't route APAC traffic off when scaling. add action to confirm regional autoscaler configs.
- runbook pointer: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/tokenizer (follow "latency spike -> rollback feature flag" section).
- quick commands: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=tokenizer -o wide`, `kubectl logs deploy/tokenizer-workers -c tokenizer --since=10m`
Priya N: taking primary now. immediate items on my plate: verify rollback consistency across regions, confirm no other feature flags toggled, validate heap settings on g-12-03 and g-12-04.
Shane L: I'll collect GC logs and heap histograms into /shared/incidents/INC-7214. will also run the local repro load test (script: `scripts/load/tokenizer_burst_test.sh`) on staging and compare latency distribution.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-7214 status changed: mitigation_applied -> monitoring (11:13 UTC).
Alex (infra): remaining risk: we still see intermittent >5s tails for long sequences (seq_len>1024). hypothesis: KV cache warming + partial eviction thrash. next steps:
- Priya to run a controlled rolling-restart on tokenizer-workers in us-east-1 to clear any residual memory fragmentation (safety: one at a time).
- Shane to revert any GC tuning that was part of the recent deploy if repro succeeds.
- Maria to confirm customer outreach and log links for CS.
Action items (owners & ETA):
- Priya N: run rolling restart + verify P95 back to <500ms for short requests, <1.5s for typical generation (ETA 20m).
- Shane L: collect GC/heap dumps & run load repro in staging, attach findings to INC-7214 (ETA 1h).
- Maria T: customer comms and CS sync, send initial note and follow-up plan (ETA 30m).
- Alex (infra): follow up on autoscaler regional config (ETA 2h).
Priya N: starting rolling restart now (will throttle to 1 pod / 3 min). I'll post progress updates.
Alex (infra): FYI — if rolling restart doesn't clear tails, fallback is to route additional traffic to dedicated-tokenizer variant (lower perf but more stable) and schedule a deeper rollback of the last full deploy.
Maria T: cs note draft: short timeline + what we did + next steps + apology. will include contact and timeline for RCA.
Priya N: rolling restart progress: pod tokenizer-7 restarted (11:21), pod tokenizer-8 restarted (11:24). monitoring shows P95 continuing to drop.
Shane L: GC logs uploaded to /shared/incidents/INC-7214/gc/ and I pushed a short analysis: found frequent full-gc spikes correlated with the kv-prefetch toggle under burst. attaching to ticket.
Priya N: after current cycle P95 for short requests ~420ms, long seq tails still ~2.8s for a handful of requests. overall error rate <1%. marking as monitoring but staying on call.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-7214 moved to status: under_observation (11:28 UTC).
Alex (infra): handoff summary for next on-call:
- status: mitigated, monitoring. primary Priya N (now) -> Shane L secondary.
- what happened: kv-prefetch toggle caused GC thrash under burst traffic -> high latency + errors. rollback + scale + routing fixed majority of errors.
- customer impact: ~1100 failed calls (mostly short window 11:02–11:12), 3 high-volume customers flagged for outreach.
- follow-ups: GC tuning review, autoscaler regional headroom check, regression test in CI for kv-prefetch under burst.
- docs/runbook: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/tokenizer (add a short note to the rollback section that we used `deploy-2026-11-kv-prefetch` rollback id).
Priya N: taking handoff. I'll run one more verification sweep at 11:45 and then update INC-7214 with final status and proposed RCA timeline.
Maria T: I'll send initial customer note now and schedule a postmortem meeting for tomorrow 16:00 UTC. posting comms thread to #customer-notifications.
Alex (infra): thanks team. leaving primary to Priya. off to catch up on other tickets. :wave: 
Priya N: thanks Alex, acknowledged. staying primary. will ping if anything changes. :mag:"
